findings.claim: Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed or formatted by the compiling assembly (TypeCollector bails out on metadata-only types). This feature adds an explicit opt-in path that bypasses that rule through GeneratedFormatterCollector rather than TypeCollector, so L11 is not contradicted. It is recorded here as checked and fine.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] metadata-only types get no formatter by default; the new explicit [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] opt-in is a separate collector path, so the L11 behaviour in TypeCollector.cs:367 is unchanged.

findings.claim: New diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are added with docs, the index and AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md entries. Existing L4 severities are for other IDs, so there is no conflict. This also follows the convention of adding release notes.

receipt_plan.detail: [L4] diagnostic severities are recorded per ID; the new IDs 019-022 are Errors, consistent with the convention of recording them in the Unshipped release file.

findings.claim: The analyzer descriptors for MsgPack019-022 are registered in SupportedDiagnostics, but the diagnostics are reported only from the generator via RegisterSourceOutput. They are never reported by the analyzer's own Initialize code, so the analyzer-only package (L1) will not show them. The docs describe them as analyzer diagnostics.

receipt_plan.detail: Search MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer.Initialize for GeneratedFormatterMustBePartial usage; it is only referenced from the generator's GeneratedFormatterCollector.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Implement the formatter attribute with contractless default plus an optional SurrogateType whose [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes map members by name. The type's own attributes are not read, and constructor parameters are unsupported (this is the current change).

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless-only, as the maintainer's simplistic suggestion: no SurrogateType. In addition, honour any [DataContract] or [MessagePackObject] and [Key] attributes present on T. This means removing the surrogate code and reading attributes from T in the collector.
